final: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as bench FROM order_averages), filtered AS (SELECT oa.orderslink, oa.avg_rebtotal, oa.avg_net_fee_rate, (oa.avg_net_fee_rate - b.bench) as excess FROM order_averages oa CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE oa.avg_net_fee_rate > b.bench) SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as avg_rebates, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as avg_net_fees, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM filtered
